info.title: MediCore API
info.description:
REST API for **MediCore**, a multi-tenant pharmacy ERP: product catalog, batch inventory (FEFO), purchasing, POS billing, accounting and statutory compliance.

## Base URL and versioning
All endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Breaking changes ship under a new version prefix.

## Authentication
1. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or `/auth/register` to create a workspace).
2. The API sets an HttpOnly `medicore_session` cookie. Browsers send it automatically.
3. Scripts and integrations can send the same token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Sessions expire after inactivity; repeated failed sign-ins lock the account temporarily.

## Workspaces (tenants)
Business endpoints act on one workspace. Send:
- `x-organization-id` — required; the user needs an active membership.
- `x-branch-id` — optional; required for branch-scoped work such as stock, POS and purchasing.

Every request is checked server-side for membership, branch assignment, role permissions and the plan's modules.

## Subscriptions
A lapsed subscription keeps data readable but blocks writes with `402 SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE`. Endpoints outside the plan return `403 FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED`. A suspended workspace returns `403`.

## Money, quantities and dates
- Money and quantities are **decimal strings** (`"120.50"`, `"2.000"`) to avoid floating-point rounding. Amounts are in INR.
- Dates are ISO 8601 (`2026-04-01`); timestamps are UTC.

## Errors
Every error uses one envelope:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Request validation failed", "details": [{ "field": "lines.0.quantity", "message": "Required" }], "correlationId": "…" } }
```

Branch on `code`, which is stable; `message` is for display. Send `x-correlation-id` to trace a request in server logs.

## Pagination
List endpoints accept `page` (from 1), `pageSize` (max 200), `sortBy` and `sortDirection`, and return `{ items, pageInfo }`.

## Idempotency
`POST /sales/invoices` accepts an `idempotencyKey`: retrying with the same key returns the original invoice instead of billing twice.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Sign up, sign in and out, password recovery, email verification, invitations and session management.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Workspace profile and settings, branches and warehouses, members, roles and permissions, onboarding checklist and subscription.

tags.name: Audit log
tags.description: Immutable record of security-relevant and business events in the workspace.

tags.description: Products, barcodes, categories, manufacturers and GST tax rates (HSN-based, effective-dated).

tags.description: Vendors (suppliers) and customers, including GST registration and credit terms.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Batches with expiry, FEFO allocation, stock ledger, adjustments, transfers, stock counts, recalls and expiry tracking.

tags.name: Purchasing
tags.description: Purchase orders, goods receipts (GRN), purchase invoices, vendor payments, purchase returns and vendor ledgers.

tags.name: Sales & POS
tags.description: POS and wholesale invoices with FEFO batch picking, sales returns, customer receipts, outstanding balances and statements.

tags.name: Accounting
tags.description: Double-entry chart of accounts, journals and reversals, ledgers, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, expenses and period locks.

tags.name: Compliance
tags.description: Schedule H1 register, drug licences and expiry alerts, GST sales/purchase summaries and integration settings.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Dashboard KPIs, sales summary, stock valuation, receivable/payable aging, CSV exports, notifications and global search.

tags.name: Platform admin
tags.description: SaaS operator console for platform superadmins: tenants, plans and limits, subscriptions and usage.

session-token.description: The same session token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` by scripts and integrations.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show to users.

correlationId.description: Echo of `x-correlation-id`; quote it in support requests.

OrganizationId.name: x-organization-id
OrganizationId.description: Workspace (organization) the request acts on. The user must hold an active membership.

BranchId.name: x-branch-id
BranchId.description: Branch context for branch-scoped data (stock, POS, purchasing). The user must be assigned to it.

ValidationError.description: The request body, query or path failed validation. See `details` for each field.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session. Sign in via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

SubscriptionInactive.description: The workspace subscription has lapsed: data stays readable but new postings are blocked.

error.message: Subscription has lapsed. Renew to continue posting.

Forbidden.description: Missing permission, branch assignment, plan module (`FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED`) or the workspace is suspended.

error.message: You do not have permission to perform this action

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in this workspace.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state: duplicates, invalid state transitions, locked periods, stock or credit rules.

error.message: The request conflicts with the current state

AccountLocked.description: Too many failed sign-in attempts; the account is temporarily locked.
